public.title: Maximum Frequency Stack
public.description: Process ["push",value] and ["pop"] on an empty frequency stack. Pop removes a value with greatest current frequency; ties choose the most recently pushed surviving occurrence. Push returns null and pop returns the removed integer. Pop is called only on a nonempty stack. At most 500 operations; values between -10000 and 10000.
hints: Group push events by the frequency reached at that moment.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The highest-frequency group is itself a recency stack. Removing its last value restores the previous frequency group. O(1) expected time per operation.
